input.summary: Replace the illusory cap base (Fees = USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form) with the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000.
input.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the cap is measured by "Fees", which Section 1.5 defines as only the USD 12,000 one-time Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is effectively USD 12,000 and far below our floor of twelve months' charges. We have moved the cap to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000; the Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap as already drafted.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
